dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the competition the last time...

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Yeah, come to think about it, you and your Saurian companion were certainly head and shoulders above the duos I usually see. I have no complaints about my loss.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: I must congratulate you two for clinching the championship too! And now, it's time for me to learn from you two!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You and Fluffy performed really well too! Let's keep up the great work together!
